messages:
incident-bot: PAGER - SEV2 - spike in external-action executions (agent runtime) starting 10:12 UTC. Token/compute surge causing elevated 95th latency and retries for /v1/generate on hosted. Impact: increased latencies and some partial responses. Auto-escalate to oncall. https://internal.monitoring/r/alerts/1765554321

alex_nguyen: oncall here, grabbing it. checking telemetry and tracing.

priya.chopra: seeing many long-running agent calls from a handful of tenants, plus a ton of structured-json outputs being generated. hypothesis: cascading external-action loops + no prefix cache. plan: soft-cap exec surface, disable structured_output for free/oss plans, and add tenant-level rate-limit.

leo_morales: +1 to soft cap. recommend rate-limit rule: external_action.exec per-tenant -> 2rps burst 5 for 10m, fallback to text-only.

maria_ops: customer-impact: approx 1200 customers showing increased latency; ~40 high-usage tenants contributing >60% exec load. will prepare customer comms for affected high-usage tenants only.

alex_nguyen: executing mitigations now:
```bash
# flip feature flag to text-only structured output for free tier
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/flags -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"structured_output.mode":"text-only","scope":"free"}'

# throttle exec surface per tenant
curl -X POST https://ratelimiter.internal/admin/rules -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RL' -d '{"resource":"external_action.exec","scope":"tenant","limit":"2rps","burst":5,"duration":"10m"}'
```

eng_oncall_bot: ack - action queued, applying flag change. /incident ack by alex_nguyen

priya.chopra: flag change succeeded: structured_output.mode=text-only for scope=free (rollout id 78e2). throttling rule accepted by rate-limiter (rule_id: rl-2026).

alex_nguyen: telemetry update at +4m: 95th latency down ~35%, error rate down 28%, exec QPS from top tenants reduced by ~70%. still watching for residual KV cache pressure.

leo_morales: leaving a short-lived kill-switch in runtime: if exec CPU > 80% for next 5m, drop external_action payloads to a header-only call (no JSON). Patch pushed to proxy (rev: proxy-1.14.3).

maria_ops: sending targeted notice to 40 tenants now with suggested mitigation (reduce agent recursion, increase prefix hints). template: "We're seeing elevated tool-exec activity; we've applied temporary rate limits and made structured output text-only to reduce latency. We're monitoring and will follow up."

tomas_kovac: taking midnight oncall in 30m. any handoff notes?

alex_nguyen: handoff: mitigations applied (flags + ratelimit + proxy patch). visible improvement but continue 30m watch. no code rollback required. postmortem to be scheduled tomorrow. handoff to @tomas_kovac at 23:00 UTC.

priya.chopra: logging actions to incident board and attaching metrics snapshot. will include replay steps and quick rollback commands.

maria_ops: scheduling customer follow-ups and ops briefing. prepping postmortem invite.

incident-bot: Incident 1765554321 status -> mitigated (partial). Please update ops checklist and record timeline.

alex_nguyen: closing thread for active mitigation; will reopen if regressions. :white_check_mark:
